title: "Toward" left label
description: Left header label changes from "Destino" to "Hacia" ("toward") — reframes the column as direction-of-travel rather than a generic "destination" noun, which can read slightly more natural for riders scanning headsigns. Right label ("Próxima salida") is unchanged.

changes.intent: Frame the destination column as direction of travel ("toward X") rather than a bare noun label.
changes.detail: Change the static text of the first header span from "Destino" to "Hacia". No structural or style change.
